Overview.Name: Meka Venkatavijayalakshmi
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (50 g)
Option 3: Vegetable upma (small bowl) & boiled egg (1)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & grilled chicken (small portion) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since gall stones are present, avoid deep fried foods and use light pan cooking methods.
Keep meals simple and not very oily to support digestion and reduce discomfort.
Stress cravings can be managed by choosing makhana or buttermilk instead of fried snacks.
Because your goal is mental wellbeing, focus on regular meal timing rather than strict restriction.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch to support better sleep and digestion.
